title: Baxter Reports Second-Quarter 2026 Results
summary: Second-quarter sales of $2.96 billion increased 5% on both a reported and organic basis,1, 2 reflecting growth in all segments and divisions Second-quarter U.S. GAAP3 diluted earnings per share (EPS) of $0.26; adjusted diluted EPS of $0.56 Company raises full-year 2026 financial outlook Baxter International Inc. (NYSE:BAX), a global medtech leader, today reported results for the second quarter of 2026. “Our second-quarter results exceeded expectations on both the top and bottom lines, driven by both operating performance and an additional benefit from a tariff refund that was not previously contemplated in our guidance,” said Andrew Hider, president and CEO. “While we’re encouraged by this steady progress and core operating momentum, we remain focused on the work ahead.
